releaseStatus: working-implementation; not a validated production release

statusDefinitions.fully-supported: Passes the named bounded fixtures in the named environment; not universal syntax coverage.
statusDefinitions.partially-supported: Implemented with documented limits or incomplete verification.
statusDefinitions.planned: Not implemented or not validated for release.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Deliberately unavailable; preserve source and disclose the boundary.

environment: Windows 11; Node 22.22.0; Chromium 153.0.8010.12; browser-engine-specific results in validation.md

features.approach: CommonMark + remark-gfm
features.acceptance: Source unchanged; expected semantic headings, lists, links and inline content retained

features.approach: CodeMirror + IndexedDB versioned snapshots
features.acceptance: Reload restores source; bundle import restores image references; conflicting tabs retain copies

features.approach: KaTeX HTML/MathML with restricted macros
features.acceptance: Fractions, roots, matrices, aligned equations, cases, sums, chemistry and explicit tags render; bad commands report diagnostics

features.approach: Escaping and single-dollar opt-out
features.acceptance: Escaped dollars and code remain literal
features.limits: Ambiguous unescaped currency is not automatically classified; backslash delimiters unavailable

features.approach: GFM semantic tables and native print CSS
features.acceptance: 180 rows and end marker survive extraction; repeated headers visually inspected
features.limits: Pathological oversized cells and nested layouts require adjustment; no merged cells

features.approach: Two-column flow directive
features.acceptance: Scientific fixture visibly has two columns in PDF
features.limits: Nested columns and aligned independent column containers unsupported; very long mixed columns not exhaustively tested

features.approach: Positioned block interpolation, scroll ownership and ResizeObserver
features.acceptance: Both directions move corresponding panels; disabling preserves independent scroll
features.limits: Exact one-line alignment across all nested layouts remains unverified

features.approach: Content-addressed raster and sanitized SVG assets; decoded size/signature checks
features.acceptance: Uploaded PNG and sanitized SVG survive reload/bundle and appear in actual PDF; forged or unsafe formats rejected
features.limits: JPEG/WebP/GIF code paths need expanded fixture coverage; GIF static-frame behavior disclosed

features.approach: Explicit credential-free browser fetch into local assets
features.acceptance: Missing remote image has visible diagnostic and blocks normal export
features.limits: Live provider/CORS combinations not comprehensively tested; upload alternative available

features.approach: Supported Mermaid diagram families; sanitized SVG and controlled styling
features.acceptance: Supported diagrams render as SVG with no executable scripts
features.limits: Family-specific visual coverage remains incomplete; custom styles and configuration restricted

features.approach: Opt-in sandboxed YouTube/Vimeo embed; static link fallback
features.acceptance: No iframe before click; provider request mocked; sandbox present
features.limits: No poster selection; real provider playback is unverified

features.approach: Pinned Chromium, shared renderer, actual PDF.js preview
features.acceptance: PDF signature, text extraction, all rows, fonts, links, tags and real preview/download checked
features.limits: Bounded regression corpus; no universal pagination or PDF/UA promise

features.approach: Chromium screenshot and PDF page rasterization
features.acceptance: PNG dimensions/signature checked; page-image ZIP and selected-block requests succeed
features.limits: Automatic over-limit fallback and 200-page boundary need stress verification; selected region means a whole block

features.approach: Self-contained shared renderer output
features.acceptance: Embedded font data; no script tags; warning placeholders retained

features.approach: Semantic controls, visible focus, independent theme tokens
features.acceptance: Zero selected WCAG axe violations in tested light/dark fixture; mobile has no viewport overflow
features.limits: Human screen-reader and usability studies not performed

features.approach: Semantic document landmark, headings, labels, alt text, Chromium tags and outlines
features.acceptance: Tagged PDF with semantic source structure, searchable text, links, alt text and outlines
features.limits: Chromium does not provide a PDF/UA conformance guarantee; dedicated structure-tree and assistive-technology validation remains required

features.approach: Escaped raw HTML, sanitization, bounded workers, origin/host checks, tokens, no server URL fetching
features.acceptance: Unsafe source cannot execute; forged image, invalid options, origin and artifact-access tests pass
features.limits: Container/OS isolation, comprehensive abuse and penetration testing remain release gates

features.approach: Worker parsing, bounded math cache and unchanged-block reuse
features.acceptance: Thirty-sample automated 104 KB/100-equation run completes below regression ceiling
features.limits: Original 4-core/8GB mixed-image and 20-page export budgets not established

features.approach: Local scripts and non-root Linux Dockerfile
features.acceptance: Local build and service exercised
features.limits: Docker engine unavailable; container validation pending

features.approach: Accessible rendering of cite... markers into numbered references
features.acceptance: Citation marker remains source-preserving and renders as labeled reference with generated list
features.limits: External bibliographic metadata, CSL styles and source resolution are not implemented

features.approach: Future service-worker cache
features.acceptance: Cold offline startup with saved documents

features.approach: Separate fidelity-tested adapters
features.acceptance: Adapter-specific artifact verification

features.approach: Preserve source for unsupported LaTeX/HTML; sanitize uploaded SVG
